### `src/components/brand/Logo.module.css`

- **L25 · off-ramp-typography** — `.wordmark` sets font-family, font-size, letter-spacing outside a type style.
  - Rationale: The Birdy wordmark is brand artwork set in Bricolage bold with tight tracking; it is not text in the type ramp.
- **L32 · off-ramp-typography** — `.logo[data-size='lg'] .wordmark` sets font-size outside a type style.
  - Rationale: Larger wordmark for the sign-in page; part of the logo artwork, sized with the logo rather than the type ramp.

### `src/components/ui/Avatar.module.css`

- **L1 · off-ramp-typography** — `.avatar` sets font-size, line-height, letter-spacing outside a type style.
  - Rationale: Avatar initials are sized to fit the circle, not to read as text; each avatar size picks its own font size from the primitives.
- **L15 · off-ramp-typography** — `.avatar[data-size='xs']` sets font-size outside a type style.
  - Rationale: Avatar initials scale with the avatar size (xs); component-specific, uses primitives.
- **L21 · off-ramp-typography** — `.avatar[data-size='md']` sets font-size outside a type style.
  - Rationale: Avatar initials scale with the avatar size (md); component-specific, uses primitives.
- **L27 · off-ramp-typography** — `.avatar[data-size='lg']` sets font-family, font-size outside a type style.
  - Rationale: Large avatar initials switch to the display family to match profile headers; component-specific, uses primitives.

### `src/features/assistant/FocusCard.module.css`

- **L64 · off-ramp-typography** — `.number` sets font-family, font-size outside a type style.
  - Rationale: Focus card step numbers are display numerals inside a small pill; a one-off, kept on primitives rather than adding a ramp style for one use.

### `src/routes/dev/ComponentSpecimens.module.css`

- **L15 · off-ramp-typography** — `.name` sets font-family, font-size, letter-spacing outside a type style.
  - Rationale: Dev-only specimen page label (src/routes/dev, never shipped); not product UI.
